summary: Implementation covers the main scheduler backlog slice: shared scoring with class bias, explicit priority, bounded age boost, retry bonus, human boost, durable score_summary queue decisions, API exposure, ordered/deferred worker records, advisory-only owned-path overlap, and the planned validation surface passes including coverage at 99.04%. It is not fully conformant because suppressed provider-recovery candidates can still consume the effective dispatch window beyond the finite overfetch buffer, and some saved-plan edge regressions are not covered.
gaps: Make provider cooldown and provider/model circuit-breaker suppression fill the requested dispatch limit by continuing past suppressed candidates until enough eligible work is found or the queue is exhausted; today _list_status() only asks for _scheduler_candidate_fetch_limit(limit), so more suppressed high-score candidates than that buffer can still block eligible lower-score work.

Add the saved worker-level retry-aware ordering regression: an infrastructure-failure retry should receive the +3 retry bonus, but must still lose to materially higher-priority new work in actual ready/provisioning dispatch order.

Add a durable circuit-breaker defer regression with a task attempt present, asserting a QueueDecision with decision=deferred, reason_code=PROVIDER_MODEL_CIRCUIT_OPEN, and a machine-readable score_summary.suppression payload. Existing circuit tests verify skipping/no cooldown event but do not prove the durable deferred decision record.
